meta.what: FleetOps warehouse fleet log: 20 Nova Carter AMRs, one-way traffic, pick -> pack station -> charge
meta.generated_by: make_fleet_log.py (fleet.py, the same logic the Isaac Sim scene renders)

units.t: seconds since the start of the run

meta.zones: zone N = aisle N; each robot picks only from its own zone

error_codes.BIN_EMPTY: arrived at a bin the system counts as stocked, found it empty

event_types.job_assigned: a robot got a job: task pick (bin, sku, system_qty) or charge (dock)
event_types.picked: unit taken from the bin; qty_left is physical, system_qty_left is the system count
event_types.station_assigned: loaded robot got a pack-station slot
event_types.stations_full: every pack-station slot was taken; the robot drives the holding loop and retries
event_types.delivered: unit handed over at a pack station; ends a pick job
event_types.charging_started: robot parked on a dock and started charging
event_types.charging_done: battery back to 95%+; ends a charge job
event_types.waiting: robot has been stopped by traffic for 2 s (normal queuing, not a fault)
event_types.resumed: robot moving again after a logged wait; waited_s is how long
event_types.error_raised: robot error code set: DRIVE_FAULT, OVERHEAT, LOW_BATTERY or BIN_EMPTY
event_types.bin_count_corrected: robot found a bin empty that the system counted as stocked; system count set to 0
event_types.restocked: replenishment refilled bins that ran out normally
event_types.idle: robot had nothing to pick in its zone
event_types.demo_command: a scripted or presenter demo fault (inject / clear / shrink) and its result
